svg.title: The Andes and the Southern Cone
svg.desc: Situation map covering 88.0°W to 32.0°W, 56.0°S to 3.0°N. A reference plate: one mountain wall, and the three climates it makes. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief.
